title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Insertion of Sensitive…
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 have a vulnerability where sensitive information may be inserted into log files. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially access sensitive data through information exposure. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.5.
